scope: Explicit clearance release of a completed own MOVE observed as WAIT; not complete owner migration or physical flow acceptance.
before: CortexClearRelease recognised active MOVE and recorded STOP holds, but not a completed same-visit MOVE observed as WAIT. The executor/adoption paths already allowed a proven settled leg. The release path could therefore leave such an actor without formation handback.
implementation: Within the existing atomic per-actor release block, recognise WAIT only with a typed five-field original MOVE receipt, exact private retiring visit context and private movement target, finite unchanged expected destination within0.25m, finite speed below0.278m/s, ASL-to-native-AGL target proximity within1.5m and vertical difference within0.75m, and unchanged nonempty native mission-order receipt. This proof grants actor recognition and the existing movement handback gate only. Existing on-foot/task/medical/external ownership, restore option and admitted formation-parent checks still apply. No new destination, teleport, retry, timer or worker.

validation.focused: 10 existing native-task release tests passed; extended the existing boundary case for foreign visit/route/target, STOP, movement, distance and wrong floor.

limits: Offline evidence only; audits paused. Not proof of physical following, coherent entry/exit or performance budget.
Only explicit release path changed; no claim that this explains all historical stragglers.
WAIT-only additional receipt/position/route observations use the existing bounded actor loop; cost unmeasured.
Producer checkpoint/replay, aggregate owner-ready proof and external controller handovers remain incomplete.
